text: おとうさんに　とってきてね　って　おねがい　してるの

structure.jp: おねがい　してるの

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: とってきてね　って
patterns.explanation: って is casual speech for と; it repeats what was said. とってきてね　って　おねがいする = 'ask (him) to go get one'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, for something happening now. おねがいしてる = 'am asking'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a casual sentence explains or softens, often used by children and women. おねがいしてるの = 'I'm asking, you see'.
